# Mastery Goals

## Graph
```{r}
Fig1_MasteryGoals <- scaleScores %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MasteryGoal_score_byAvg)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
      aes(
        x = Time,
        y = MasteryGoal_score_byAvg,
        fill = sectionID
      )
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.3
      , outliers = FALSE
      , width = 0.5
      , aes(
        color = sectionID
      )
    ) +
    labs(y = "Mastery Goals\n(average score)", x = "time")+
    theme_pubr()+
    expand_limits(y=0)+
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )+
    textTheme(size = 11)+
    boxTheme() + 
    addMeanHorizontalBar(
      barPosition = position_dodge2(width = 0.3)
    ) +
    addMeanSE_vertBar(

    ) +
    scale_color_manual(

      , values = c("lightblue", "magenta")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      limits = c("trad", "specs")
      , values = c("lightblue", "magenta")
    ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sectionID
  )
```

# Principle Component Analysis
Make wide form
```{r}
forPCA_wide<-scaleScores %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("BelongingPost_")
      , -starts_with("ClassEngagement_")
      , -SC0
      , -(ClassEngagement_1:ParentEd_2)
    )%>%
  select(
    ID
    , sectionID
    , labSection
    , Time
    , ends_with("_byAvg")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, sectionID, labSection)
    , names_from = Time
    , values_from = where(is.numeric)
  )

forPCA_change <- forPCA_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Fixed = Fixed_score_byAvg_post - Fixed_score_byAvg_pre
    , Growth = Growth_score_byAvg_post - Growth_score_byAvg_pre
    , SciEfficacy = SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_post - SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_pre
    , MasteryGoal = MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_post - MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    , PerformanceGoal = PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_post - PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    # , PerformanceApproach = PerformanceApproach_score_byAvg_post - PerformanceApproach_score_byAvg_pre
    # , PerformanceAvoid = PerformanceAvoid_score_byAvg_post - PerformanceAvoid_score_byAvg_pre
    , Interest = Interest_score_byAvg_post - Interest_score_byAvg_pre
    , Belonging = BelongingPre_score_byAvg_post - BelongingPre_score_byAvg_pre
  ) %>%
  select(
    -(ends_with("_byAvg_pre"))
    , -(ends_with("_byAvg_post"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(sectionID) %>%
  mutate(
    # use the section average for belonging change if missing
    # Retains the ones who took the full intended post-survey, but probably more reflective than their
    # post responses specific to Brain and Behavior
    Belonging = ifelse(is.na(Belonging), mean(Belonging, na.rm = TRUE), Belonging)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    if_all(where(is.numeric), ~!is.na(.))
  )

forPCA_change
```

## Create PCA results

```{r}
pca_res_change <- prcomp(forPCA_change %>% select(-ID, -sectionID, -labSection), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)
```

## Decide on clusters

How many PCs explain 80-90% variance?
Out to PC4 gets to just about 80% variance
```{r}
summary(pca_res_change)

n_pcs <- 4
```

Decide number of clusters

Elbow method
```{r}
wss <- numeric()

for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(1:10, wss, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares")

```

Silhouette Method
```{r}
library(cluster)

sil_width <- numeric()

for (k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  ss <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(pca_res_change$x[, 1:2]))
  sil_width[k] <- mean(ss[, 3])
}

plot(1:10, sil_width, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Average silhouette width")

```

## Make clusters

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
n_clusters = 3
clusters_change <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = n_clusters, nstart = 25)$cluster  # choose number of clusters

pca_df_change <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res_change$x[,1]
  , PC2 = pca_res_change$x[,2]
  , PC3 = pca_res_change$x[,3]
  , ID = forPCA_change$ID
  , sectionID = forPCA_change$sectionID
  , labSection = forPCA_change$labSection
  , cluster = factor(clusters_change)
) 
```


## Check loadings
```{r}
# PCA loadings
loadings_change <- pca_res_change$rotation

# Optionally look at the top contributing variables for PC1-3
top_PC1_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,1]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC2_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,2]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC3_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,3]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC4_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,4]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC5_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,5]), decreasing = TRUE)

print("PC1")
head(top_PC1_change, 8)  # top 8 contributors to PC1
print("PC2")
head(top_PC2_change, 8)  # top 8 contributors to PC2
print("PC3")
head(top_PC3_change, 8)  # top 8 contributors to PC3
print("PC4")
head(top_PC4_change, 8)  # top 8 contributors to PC4
print("PC5")
head(top_PC5_change, 8)  # top 8 contributors to PC5
```

### emmeans

```{r}

library(emmeans)

vars <- c("Fixed","Growth","MasteryGoal",
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","SciEfficacy","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")
  
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ factor(cluster)")),
               data = change_clusters)
  
  em <- emmeans(model, ~ cluster)
  
  print(multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters))
}
```

```{r}
cluster_pre_post <- change_clusters %>%

    scaleScores %>%
      filter(
        # Time == "post"

      select(
        ID
        , Time
        , Fixed_score_byAvg
        , Growth_score_byAvg
        , SciEfficacy_score_byAvg
        , MasteryGoal_score_byAvg
        , PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg
        , Interest_score_byAvg
        , BelongingPre_score_byAvg
      )
     , by = "ID" 
  ) 

cluster_pre_post_long <- cluster_pre_post %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Fixed_score_byAvg:BelongingPre_score_byAvg)
    , names_to = "resp_scale"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_scale = gsub("_score_byAvg$", "", resp_scale)
    , resp_scale = case_when(
      resp_scale == "MasteryGoal" ~ "Mastery\nGoal"
      , resp_scale == "PerformanceGoal" ~ "Performance\nGoal"
      , resp_scale == "BelongingPre" ~ "Belonging"
      , resp_scale == "SciEfficacy" ~ "Sci Efficacy"
      , TRUE ~ resp_scale
    )
    , resp_scale = factor(resp_scale, levels = c("Fixed", "Growth", "Mastery\nGoal", "Performance\nGoal", "Interest", "Sci Efficacy", "Belonging"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(value)
  )
```

```{r}
    ~resp_scale
    , nrow = 1
    # , scales = "free"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y=7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1:6)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
    , legend.margin = margin(t = -5)
    , legend.key.height = unit(.15, "in")
    , strip.clip = "off"
    , strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Fig8a_prePost_scores
Fig8b_prePost_scores
```
```{r}
cluster_pre_post_clean <- cluster_pre_post %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ gsub("_score_byAvg$", "", .), 
              c(Fixed_score_byAvg,
                Growth_score_byAvg,
                SciEfficacy_score_byAvg,
                MasteryGoal_score_byAvg,
                PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg,
                Interest_score_byAvg,
                BelongingPre_score_byAvg)
    ) %>%
  rename(
    Belonging = BelongingPre
  )
```

```{r}

vars <- c("Fixed","Growth","MasteryGoal",
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","SciEfficacy","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")
  
  model <- mixed(
    as.formula(paste(v, "~ cluster * Time + (1 | ID)")),
    data = cluster_pre_post_clean
  )
  
  print(model$anova_table)
  
  p_cluster <- model$anova_table["cluster", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_time <- model$anova_table["Time", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_interaction <- model$anova_table["cluster:Time", "Pr(>F)"]

  if (p_interaction < 0.05) {
    cat("\nInteraction significant → simple effects with CLDs\n")
    
    #  Clusters at each timepoint
    cat("\n--- Cluster differences within Time ---\n")
    em1 <- emmeans(model, ~ cluster | Time)
    print(multcomp::cld(em1, Letters = letters))
    
    # Time within each cluster
    cat("\n--- Time differences within Cluster ---\n")
    em2 <- emmeans(model, ~ Time | cluster)
    print(multcomp::cld(em2, Letters = letters))
    
  } else if (p_cluster < 0.05) {
    cat("\nCluster main effect → CLD\n")
    em <- emmeans(model, ~ cluster)
    print(multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters))
    
  } else if (p_time < 0.05) {
    cat("\nTime main effect → CLD\n")
    em <- emmeans(model, ~ Time)
    print(multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters))
  }
}

```
